agendaItems.title:
File No. PS26-25956
Resolution requiring the Tampa Police Department and Tampa Fire Rescue each to submit a triennial public safety master plan to City Council and encouraging both departments to include input from the applicable first responder union or their designees in preparing the master plan beginning in 2027; providing an effective date.
 
Memorandum from Carl Brody, Assistant City Attorney, requesting that said agenda item be heard in conjunction with Item 62. (To be R/F)

agendaItems.title:
File No. E2026-8 CH 11 & 18 (UNAN)
(Ordinance being presented for second reading and adoption) - An ordinance of the City of Tampa, Florida requiring City Council to be provided notice of any changes to the Executive Order setting standards for triennial updates to the respective public safety master plans of the Tampa Police Department and Tampa Fire Rescue; repealing all ordinances or parts of ordinances in conflict therewith; providing for severability; providing an effective date. (Original motion to approve said ordinance on first reading was initiated by Viera-Maniscalco on August 6, 2026)
 
Memorandum from Carl Brody, Assistant City Attorney, requesting that said agenda item be heard in conjunction with Item 4. (To be R/F)

File No. VAC-26-08 (UNAN)
(Ordinance being presented for second reading and adoption) - An ordinance of the City of Tampa, Florida, vacating, closing, discontinuing and abandoning a portion of 43rd Street right-of-way located North of Ellicott Street and James Elementary School, South of Shadowlawn Avenue, East of 40th Street and Gary Adult High School, and West of 47th Street, as dedicated by the Plat of Revised Map of Rubensteins Subdivision, in Tampa, Hillsborough County, Florida, and as more fully described in Section 2 hereof, subject to certain covenants, conditions and restrictions as more particularly set forth herein; providing for enforcement and penalties for violations; providing for definitions, interpretations and repealing conflicts; providing for severability; providing an effective date. (Continued from May 21, 2026)(Original motion to approve said ordinance on first reading was initiated by Carlson-Viera on July 30, 2026)
 
Memorandum from Ron Wigginton, Assistant City Attorney, transmitting a second  substitute ordinance for said public hearing. (To be R/F)(Title of said substitute ordinance listed below)

agendaItems.title:
File No. DEO26-26571
Development and Funding Agreement by and between the City of Tampa, Florida, Hillsborough County, Florida, and Tampa Bay Rays, LLC.
 
Memorandum from Scott I. Steady, City Attorney, transmitting resolutions with agreements and substitute agreement for said agenda item. (To be R/F)(Title of resolutions listed below)
 
Resolution of the City of Tampa, Florida, approving a development and funding agreement by and between the City of Tampa, Hillsborough County, and Tampa Bay Rays Stadium Company, LLC; authorizing execution by the Mayor and attestation by the City Clerk; providing an effective date.
 
Resolution of the City of Tampa, Florida, approving a team non-relocation agreement by and between the City of Tampa, Hillsborough County, and the Rays Baseball Club, LLC; authorizing execution by the Mayor and attestation by the City Clerk; providing an effective date.
 
Resolution of the City of Tampa, Florida, approving a guaranty by Florida Baseball Partners, LLC., as the guarantor for the benefit of the City of Tampa and Hillsborough County; authorizing execution by the Mayor and attestation by the City Clerk; providing an effective date.
